source_text: Critics of the Resolution argue it overextends analogies, given institutional distinctions: WHO classifies FGM as having no benefits while endorsing voluntary male circumcision in high-HIV settings since 2007, based on randomized trials involving 10,000+ participants showing sustained protection.
